mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END AS user_id, u.name AS name, u.role AS role, CASE WHEN c.status != 'WAIT' THEN c.status WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM invitation i WHERE i.inviter_id = #{userId} AND i.invitee_id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END AND i.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED') ) THEN 'REQUESTED' ELSE 'WAIT' END AS status FROM couple c JOIN `user` u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END WHERE (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND c.status != 'DISCONNECTED'

SELECT CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END AS user_id, u.name AS name, u.role AS role, c.status AS status FROM couple c JOIN `user` u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END WHERE ((c.groom_id = #{userId} AND c.bride_id = #{partnerId}) OR (c.groom_id = #{partnerId} AND c.bride_id = #{userId})) AND c.status != 'DISCONNECTED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.status = 'CONNECTED' THEN 1 WHEN c.status = 'WAIT' THEN 2 ELSE 9 END, c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS name, u.role AS role FROM invitation i JOIN `user` u ON u.id = i.inviter_id WHERE i.invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND i.invitee_id IS NULL AND i.status = 'CREATED' AND i.expired_at > NOW() AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM couple WHERE (groom_id = #{userId} OR bride_id = #{userId}) AND status = 'CONNECTED' AND NOT (groom_id = #{otherUserId} OR bride_id = #{otherUserId})

SELECT status FROM couple WHERE (groom_id = #{groomId} AND bride_id = #{brideId}) OR (groom_id = #{brideId} AND bride_id = #{groomId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'CONNECTED' THEN 1 WHEN status = 'WAIT' THEN 2 ELSE 9 END, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO couple (groom_id, bride_id, status) VALUES (#{groomId}, #{brideId}, 'WAIT')
mapper.update: UPDATE couple SET status = 'CONNECTED' WHERE ((groom_id = #{groomId} AND bride_id = #{brideId}) OR (groom_id = #{brideId} AND bride_id = #{groomId})) AND status = 'WAIT'
UPDATE couple SET status = 'DISCONNECTED' WHERE ((groom_id = #{groomId} AND bride_id = #{brideId}) OR (groom_id = #{brideId} AND bride_id = #{groomId})) AND status = 'CONNECTED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM couple WHERE status = 'WAIT' AND (groom_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) OR bride_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId})) AND NOT ((groom_id = #{groomId} AND bride_id = #{brideId}) OR (groom_id = #{brideId} AND bride_id = #{groomId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO invitation (inviter_id, invitee_id, invite_code, status, expired_at) SELECT inviter_id, #{inviteeId}, invite_code, 'REQUESTED', expired_at FROM invitation WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND invitee_id IS NULL AND status = 'CREATED' AND expired_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE invitation requested INNER JOIN invitation master ON master.invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND master.invitee_id IS NULL AND master.status = 'CREATED' AND master.expired_at > NOW() SET requested.status = 'ACCEPTED', requested.expired_at = master.expired_at WHERE requested.inviter_id = master.inviter_id AND requested.invitee_id = #{inviteeId} AND requested.status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM invitation WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' AND (inviter_id IN (#{userId}, #{partnerId}) OR invitee_id IN (#{userId}, #{partnerId})) AND NOT ((inviter_id = #{userId} AND invitee_id = #{partnerId}) OR (inviter_id = #{partnerId} AND invitee_id = #{userId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitation (inviter_id, invite_code, status, expired_at) VALUES (#{inviterId}, #{inviteCode}, 'CREATED', #{expiredAt})
